description: A dark, warm oil-style still life of a laboratory bench. A glass Erlenmeyer flask of clear liquid holds faint white stringy threads. At upper right a hand holds a glass rod wound with white fibrous strands, lifting them above a small glass beaker. Another hand rests at the lower right. Behind are an old metal apparatus, amber glass bottles with worn labels, a lit candle, a rack of test tubes and petri dishes in the lower left. The painting runs edge to edge with no frame.
